title: Align artifact intake next issue with shadow observation review
user_business_goal: Align the lower-level artifact intake status next issue with the aggregate artifact readiness report after shadow observation review became the current safe app loop.
out_of_scope: raw media, raw datasets, customer/factory data, notebooks, model weights, TensorRT engines, model binaries, or model execution
live camera capture, camera SDK loading, camera credentials, GPU/hardware validation, or hardware readiness approval
production deploy/release, secrets, tokens, provider credentials, destructive migrations, production data migration, billing, legal/compliance behavior, or security boundary change
product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, model promotion approval, production PASS/NG authority, or production auto-reject behavior
acceptance_criteria: Valid artifact intake still reports ready.shadow_model_integration_issue=true so detector readiness and existing gates remain compatible.
Valid artifact intake reports next_issue.recommended_task=shadow_observation_review instead of shadow_model_integration.
Valid artifact intake next_issue includes a next action pointing to sanitized shadow observation payload submission.
Missing, unconfigured, or invalid artifact intake still recommends configure or fix intake as before.
/artifact-intake/status returns the new recommended task when FLANGE_QC_V2_ARTIFACT_INTAKE_DIR points at the template bundle.
Artifact readiness still reports submit_shadow_observation_payload and production authority remains false.
Existing artifact intake, artifact readiness, detector, HMI, product CI, and full repo tests continue to pass.
required_checks: HTTP preview smoke for /artifact-intake/status and /artifact-readiness/status when local preview is available

memory_preflight.query: FQV2 artifact intake next_issue after artifact readiness shadow observation review.
retrieved_decisions: Artifact readiness now recommends shadow_observation_review and submit_shadow_observation_payload.
Production authority, model promotion, QC/SOP tolerance approval, product spec approval, and live camera remain human-gated.
retrieved_lessons: Lower-level status endpoints should not keep stale next-task names after aggregate readiness advances to the next implementation stage.
Compatibility flags can stay stable while human-readable next actions advance.
memory_preflight.conflicts_found: runtime/Windmill daily attention is a non-app-code auth/session blocker; this task does not require Windmill secret access.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-045 PR to restore the previous artifact intake next-issue wording. Existing artifact intake validation, artifact readiness, detector status, shadow observation validator, HMI, feedback, and product CI behavior remain valid.
